'''October 2001 Melbourne Episode I tournament (21 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Melbourne, Australia on 21 October 2001. [[Lee Pullen]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3076">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-26-melbourne-oz-21-10-01d3076/ melbourne-oz-21-10-01], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 26 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-26-melbourne-oz-21-10-01d3076/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Lee Pullen]]
